PROVINCIAL SCHOLARSHIP AND EDUCATIONAL ASSISTANCE (PSEDA) 
PROGRAM 
In view of Provincial Ordinance No. ZN-25-2222, Institutionalizing the Provincial 
Scholarship and Educational Assistance (PSEdA) Program of Zamboanga del Norte, all 
School Heads are hereby directed to ensure that school grades are finalized not later 
than the third week of March. 
This is to facilitate the timely preparation of academic records required for 
learners who intend to avail of the said scholarship program. 
Immediate dissemination of and compliance with this advisory is desired.
